game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against goblin raiders.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against goblin raiders. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal vault using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the royal vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 13.
